values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/veteransmemorial ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (Veterans Memorial State Forest Campground, Benzie: rustic, seasonal closure 'open all year', managed by Interlochen SP 231-276-9511, 24 sites, $20, ORV operation between SFCG and trails allowed no, carry-in access, reservable no), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/veteransmemorial ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.'), read 2026-10-25

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/veteransmemorial ('There are 24 sites for tent and small trailer use'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (24 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic MI DNR state forest campground on the Platte River, 3.5 miles east of Honor via US-31 (Benzie Co.), managed by Interlochen State Park. Carry-in access for kayaks and canoes from the campground; brown trout, steelhead and coho in the river, with Platte Lake (6 mi west) and Crystal Lake (8 mi west) nearby. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 24 sites for 'tent and small trailer use' (boilerplate, silent on length) (all confirmed, derived -> manual). Season (manual year-round, table 'open all year') left. Type 'rustic', not equestrian; ORV operation between campground and trails not allowed. Directions (US-31) carry no road warning. Phone matches. Note trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the DNR page says the campground 'sits on the majestic Platte River' and 'is located along the Platte River', with carry-in kayak/canoe access 'from the campground'; the entry has 'not waterfront'.
